section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the participants in a single study (Study X) consisting of 247 women (mean age 29.76 years) who completed all relevant survey items. The majority identified as female (97.6%), were White (66.8% of those with ethnicity data), and were well-educated with 83.0% having an undergraduate degree or higher. The sample included a high proportion of non-traditional participants regarding sexual orientation and relationship status, with recruitment potentially influenced by a BDSM-related website portal.
